QUOTE: "Two routes, both shown in the index: 1. **Compile-time macros.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... 2. **Runtime hooks.** ... call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. It never says they are mutually exclusive, and it presents both as routes under the same `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` switch.
